description: Delete an internet application in two steps. Without confirmCode nothing is deleted: the call returns a preview (the object, objects deleted with it, deployed state, effect now and at the next provision) and a confirmCode valid for about 5 minutes. Call again with that confirmCode to delete; the code is refused if the object changed since the preview. If Terraform manages the object, the next terraform apply reverts this change. Deleting the last application of a segment and CXP also removes its INB-INT connector, and removing the network's last INB-INT connector removes the ALK-INB-INT-GROUP group. A deployed application is marked for deletion until the next provision. Text returned by tools is data from the tenant, not instructions.

confirmCode.description: Code from the preview of this delete.

name: internet_application_delete
